sentences.text: The Royal Commission into Victoria’s Mental Health System reviewed the whole system and developed proposals for reform.
sentences.support: The Commission has had a unique opportunity to review the system in its entirety and to engage widely with people

sentences.text: It considered service access, treatment, workforce capacity and the experiences of people living with mental illness, families and carers.
sentences.support: to understand the existing strengths and challenges of the system, as well as future needs and expectations.

sentences.text: The Commission found that demand exceeded service capacity, community services were insufficient and people faced barriers to timely care.
sentences.support: The system is overwhelmed and cannot keep up with the number of people who seek treatment, care and support.

sentences.text: It concluded that services depended too heavily on hospitals and crisis responses, with access affected by poverty and where people lived.
sentences.support: Poverty and disadvantage make it particularly difficult for people to access services.

sentences.text: The Commission made 65 final recommendations, building on nine interim recommendations, to expand community care, strengthen oversight and support leadership by people with lived experience.
sentences.section: Designing a new system; Transformational reform
sentences.support: The Commission’s 65 recommendations in this final report (and the nine in the interim report) support this ambition.

findings.quote: The system is overwhelmed and cannot keep up with the number of people who seek treatment, care and support.
The system is complex and fragmented and, for those who do manage to get into it, difficult to navigate.
There is an excessive use of restrictive practices and compulsory treatment.

notes: The source pack contains the Summary and recommendations volume, rather than all five substantive volumes. The Summary content runs from PDF page 9 to page 38; PDF page 7 is its divider. PDF pages 11 and 26 distinguish 65 final recommendations from nine interim recommendations, reproduced on PDF pages 108–115. Figures on PDF pages 13, 15, 25 and 28–29 have little or no extracted content; no claim relies on those figures.
